senses.gloss: लश् vi. 10U (pres. लाशयति-ते) To exercise an art. (This root is sometimes written लष् or लस्.)
लष् vt. 1U, 4U (pres. लषति-ते, लष्यति-ते) To wish, to long for, to be eager for.With अभि-, to wish, to long for, to be eager for, तेन दत्तमभिलेषुरंगनाः R.xix.12.

लस् vi. 1P (pp. लसित; pres. लसति) 1. To embrace; 2. to shine, to glitter, to flash, अंतर्हासलसत्कपोलफलकां धूर्तोऽपरां चुंबति Am.S.16, लसद्बिंबमिवेंदुबिंबम् Na.xxii.53; 3. to appear, to arise; 4. to play, to sport, to skip about.With उद्-, 1. to shine, to glitter, रुचमुल्लसमानवैनतेयद्युतिभिन्नाः फणभारिणो मणीनाम् Sis.xx.56; 2. to arise, to appear, Sis.iv.58; 3. to blow, to open, to expand.With परि-, to shine, to appear gaudy, परिलसंति वाजिव्रजाः R.G. With वि-, 1. to shine, to glitter, to flash, उपरि विलसत् कृष्णसारप्रभाणाम् Megh.i.47, R.xiii.76; 2. to appear, to arise, to be manifested, Sis.ix.87; 3. to be sportive or wanton, to play, to sport, हरिरिह मुग्धवधूनिकरे विलासिनि विलसति केलिपरे Git.G.i.; 4. to sound, to echo.
लस् Caus. (लासयति-ते) 1. to cause to shine, to adorn; 2. to cause to dance.
लशु(शू)न m.n. Garlic, निखिलरसायनमहितो गंधेनोग्रेण लशुन इव Bh.V.i.81, M.v.5.
लशु(शू)न m.n. Garlic, निखिलरसायनमहितो गंधेनोग्रेण लशुन इव Bh.V.i.81, M.v.5.
लषित a. (f. ता) Wished, desired.
लषित a. (f. ता) Wished, desired.
लसित a. (f. ता) 1. Played, sported; 2. arose, appeared; 3. moved about, (pp. of लस् q.v.).
लसित a. (f. ता) 1. Played, sported; 2. arose, appeared; 3. moved about, (pp. of लस् q.v.).
लष्व m. An actor, a dancer.
लसा f. 1. Saffron; 2. turmeric.
लास m. 1. Jumping, sporting; 2. dalliance, wanton sport; 3. dancing as practised by women; 4. soup, broth.
लसिका f. Spittle, saliva.
लसीका f. 1. Spittle; 2. pus, matter; 3. lymph; 4. the juice of the sugarcane.
लासक (I) a. (f. सिका) Playing, sporting, moving hither and thither.
लासिका f. 1. A female dancer; 2. a prostitute, a harlot.

लस्ज् vi. 1Ā (pp. लज्जित; pres. लज्जते) 1. To be ashamed, to feel shame, (often used with an inst.), Bt.xv.33; 2. to blush.With वि-, 1. to blush, to be modest, विलज्जमानां रहसि प्रतीतः पप्रच्छ रामां रमणोऽभिलाषम् R.xiv.27, K.S.i.14.
लस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. Embraced; 2. skilful, skilled.
लस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. Embraced; 2. skilful, skilled.
लस्तक m. The middle of a bow.
लस्तकिन् m. A bow.
लाषुक a. (f. का or की) Covetous, greedy.
लाषुक a. (f. का or की) Covetous, greedy.
लाषुक a. (f. का or की) Covetous, greedy.
लासक (I) a. (f. सिका) Playing, sporting, moving hither and thither.
लासक (II) m. 1. A dancer; 2. a peacock; 3. an epithet of Śiva.
लासक (III) n. A room on the top of a building.
लासकी f. A female dancer.
लास्य (I) n. 1. Dancing, a dauce, R.xvi.14; 2. a dance. accompanied with singing and instrumental music; 3. a dance in which the emotions of love are represented mimically.
लास्य (II) m. A lancer.
लास्या f. A dancing girl.
